description: This file is a Java source file that generates example JSON representations of 'Thing' objects and related authorization data for testing or demonstration purposes within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ThingModelJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate and serialize JSON representations of Ditto 'Thing' models and related authorization context for testing and examples.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that takes a directory path argument and initiates the production of example JSON files.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Creates authorization context files in the specified root directory.

methods.name: produceThingModel
methods.description: Generates sample 'Thing' objects, attributes, features, and permissions, then serializes them to JSON files within the specified directory.

methods.name: createAttributeExampleJsonObject
methods.description: Creates a sample Attributes object with JSON content.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a JSON file.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string content to a specified file path.
